about: Hand-written retrieval questions for the Chakra knowledge base (src/data/models/chakra_knowledge_base.json). Each question names the chunk that should answer it by a stable part of its title, since chunk ids shift when the base is rebuilt. Written as farmers and officers ask, not copied from the titles. Used by notebooks/agros_colab_training.ipynb (BM25 against embedding retrieval) and as a floor in src/engine/chakraRetrieval.test.js. Add a question it fails; do not tune the retriever to this list.
